races.verdict: ICE CUBE wasted no time getting back on the up when second at Nottingham last week, beaten only by an in-form rival, and he can build on that effort to record a third handicap success this year. Eazy On The Eye gained a deserved victory at Epsom on her latest outing and could be the main danger, ahead of Venetian Sky . ICE CUBE (IRE) EAZY ON THE EYE VENETIAN SKY (FR)

races.verdict: It's hard to look past PUSH THE LIMIT , who admittedly has a year-long absence to overcome on his hurdling debut but showed smart form on the Flat for Ralph Beckett in 2025 and was sold for a whopping 580,000 gns. Aye Over Tee is bred to make a useful jumper and warrants a close look in the betting, while Dilrisk and Striking Midnight are a couple with frame claims having shown some promise in bumpers last season. PUSH THE LIMIT (FR) AYE OVER TEE DILRISK (FR)
